# Brief — Results and discussion

Rung: R5 of 6.  Budget: ~2,000 words, shared with `limitations`.

## Argument
A yardstick outside the engine's control agrees with the one inside it, so the arm ranking is not
self-scored (@fig:registration-accuracy).
Two molecular readouts, neither derived from pixels, place the cases in the order the pictures do
(@fig:proof-of-concept).
Closes: D1, D2.  Opens: D3.

## Must not claim
Any head-to-head win over another pipeline.  First at whole-slide scale.  Any correlation
coefficient, confidence interval or p-value, at any tier.  Absolute-fraction agreement between
imaging and deconvolution.

## Sheds
Full per-arm table -> Additional files.  Lower-tier scatters -> Additional files.  Tier-to-lineage
mapping -> Additional files.  Competitor positioning -> background.  Procedures, gating and tier
definitions -> the protocol and implementation units.

## Verify before prose
The engine's standing on the public benchmark.  That the high-accuracy, micro-on arm is the arm
that produced the proof-of-concept data.  The binarisation rule.  The deconvolution version and
mode.
